title: Conservation District Violation
description: Use this service request to report structures that do not comply with the conservation district preservation criteria. Conservation districts are a type of zoning district designation that helps to preserve and protect the character of Dallas architecturally unique neighborhoods. If this is a substandard structure in a Historical or Conservation District please report it to Code Compliance. The estimated response time for a request of this nature is 15 business days.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request to report a structure that violates conservation criteria.
actions.why: To report a structure that does not comply with preservation criteria in a Dallas conservation district, which protects the character of architecturally unique neighborhoods. The 311 request form asks whether the building is currently under construction; if Yes, whether work is new construction, an addition, or remodeling; whether the district is Historic or Conservation; whether a permit is posted; and what violation occurred.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Conservation District Violation" requests does not apply to a substandard structure in a Historic or Conservation District. If the structure is substandard, then submit a "Code Concerns" 311 request to Code Compliance instead.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Other Requests" > Choose "Conservation District Violation"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Other Requests" > Choose "Conservation District Violation"

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about a substandard structure in a historic or conservation district.
actions.why: For a substandard structure in a Historic or Conservation District. The description for "Conservation District Violation" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs this concern to Code Compliance.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "City Code Violations" > Choose "Code Concerns"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "City Code Violations" > Choose "Code Concerns"
